claims.claim_text: If an interface is flapping but RX power is fine when it's up, it is probably not the SFP. Flapping like that is more often a bad fibre bend or a loose patch in the tray, so check the run to the frame first and reseat the patch at both ends, and leave the SFP alone unless it starts again.
claims.symptom: interface flapping down and up every few minutes with RX power fine when up
claims.check_step: Check the fibre run from the port to the frame for bends
claims.action: Reseat the patch at both ends
